sentences: Chlorhexidine is a disinfectant and antiseptic that is used for skin disinfection before surgery, to sterilize surgical instruments, and for various other medical and dental applications
It is effective against a range of microorganisms, but does not inactivate spores
Chlorhexidine is available in different formulations, including liquid and powder forms, and can be used to disinfect both the skin of patients and the hands of healthcare providers
Chlorhexidine has been used since the 1950s and has a broad spectrum of antiseptic activity

It is effective in preventing healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and has been used in various applications, including skin cleansing, skin decolonization, preoperative showering and bathing, vascular catheter site preparation, and oral decontamination
Chlorhexidine has been reported to have a low risk of causing side effects such as skin irritation, teeth discoloration, and allergic reactions, similar to other topical antiseptics
